Show a signed stack, a dropped or reverted mempool transaction, a Min-circuit proof for the same message, or an op whose `bytes4(op.callData)` dodges the two-selector filter, that moves wallet or EOA assets to a destination the owner never signed. Identity: (assets leaving the wallet, their destination) == (ops, maxFee) the wallet owner signed.'
